summary: QA completed with two JS bugs found and fixed within QA scope.

BUG 1 — ShowJumpToModal() missing: PHP toolbar button called viewer.ShowJumpToModal() but no such method existed in viewer.js. Added ShowJumpToModal() using Bootstrap 5 Modal API (new bootstrap.Modal(el).show()).

BUG 2 — JumpTo() broken: used undeclared 'baseURL' variable and passed page number as '&episode=' (not a server-recognised parameter). Fixed to call ajax_resolvePageNumber via ajaxBaseURL + '&ajax=resolvePageNumber&pageNumber=...' and navigate to the returned data.viewURL on success.
PHPStan: no errors. PHPUnit: 60/60 pass (1 pre-existing deprecation, 1 pre-existing skip — both unrelated to this feature).

comments.note: js/viewer.js ShowJumpToModal() was missing entirely. The toolbar button onclick called viewer.ShowJumpToModal() which would throw a runtime TypeError in the browser. Fixed by adding the method using Bootstrap 5 Modal API.

js/viewer.js JumpTo() navigated using `document.location = baseURL + '&episode=' + episodeNr`. Two problems: (1) 'baseURL' is a page-scoped const not the AJAX URL; (2) &episode= is not a recognised server parameter — the server expects &episodeID= for episode resolution. Additionally, the user types a 1-based page number which is not the same as an episodeID. Fixed: JumpTo() now calls ajax_resolvePageNumber via ajaxBaseURL and navigates to viewURL from the response.
js/viewer.js JumpTo() original used 'failure' as the jQuery AJAX error callback key; the correct key is 'error'. Fixed as part of the rewrite.

summary: Code review passed. All three modified files reviewed: ReaderPage.php, Icon.php, viewer.js. Implementation follows project conventions throughout — ajax_ naming, sendAJAXSuccess/Error pattern, pt()/t() for all user-visible strings, Bootstrap 5 modal structure, and fluent Icon builder. AJAX dispatch confirmed wired automatically via BasePage::handleAJAX() using method_exists and the ajax_ prefix naming convention. No security, architecture, or correctness issues found. Two pre-existing JS bug fixes by QA (ShowJumpToModal missing, JumpTo using wrong variable and wrong server param) are correctly implemented. Three low-priority observations noted.

comments.note: js/viewer.js ShowJumpToModal(): creates a new bootstrap.Modal instance on every call. The canonical BS5 approach is bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl), which is safe to call repeatedly and avoids attaching duplicate internal event listeners. Functional as-is but could be improved.

assets/classes/Page/ReaderPage.php renderImages(): if array_search() returns false (episode not in fetched list), $currentPageNumber falls back to 0. This produces a 'Page 0 of N' header and pre-fills the modal input with 0 (below min=1). HTML5 validation prevents submitting 0, so no crash, but the header text is visually wrong. Extremely rare edge case — the reader guard already requires episodes to exist — but worth hardening.

js/viewer.js SavePosition(), ToggleBookmark(), ToggleImageBookmark(), UseAsCover(): pre-existing use of 'failure' as the jQuery AJAX error callback key (should be 'error'). Not introduced by this feature — QA correctly fixed only the new JumpTo() method. Flagged as pre-existing debt for a future cleanup pass.
